# Request a proposal.
Tell us about your association. We reply within one business day.

## Tell us about your association.

Share a few details and we will follow up to schedule a conversation with your board. No cost, no obligation.

- **[773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652)** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM

- **[service@centerpointmgmt.com](mailto:service@centerpointmgmt.com)** Replies within one business day

- **5107 N Western Ave, Suite 1S** Chicago, IL 60625

## What happens next.

### We reply
Within one business day, to confirm details and set a time to talk.

### We review
We meet your board and review the declaration, budget, and current contracts.

### We propose
You receive a written scope and a flat monthly fee for your property.

### You decide
No obligation. Compare us with our free [proposal scorecard](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/tools/compare-management-proposals).
